content.title: Dhurandhar 2 Review, Release Highlights: Aditya Dhar Says Sorry For Show Cancellations And Delays
content.text: Shilpa Shetty And Family Watch Dhurandhar 2 In Mumbai Shilpa Shetty, her sister Shamita Shetty, and their mother watched Dhurandhar 2 in Mumbai today. When the paparazzi asked Shamita about the movie, she called it "superb." Meanwhile, Shilpa said, "Aag laga di." Celebrities Attend Dhurandhar 2 Screening In Mumbai Preity Zinta, Celina Jaitly, Arjun Rampal, Gabriella Demetriades, and several others attended a special screening of Dhurandhar 2 in Mumbai. Dhurandhar 2 Sparks Meme Fest As X Goes Down Amid the ongoing buzz around Dhurandhar 2, social media users have been having a field day after X went down right around the film’s climax time. Reacting to the outage, one user joked, “X down at the time of #Dhurandhar2 climax. PEAK PLANNING by #AdityaDhar,” turning the situation into a viral moment. Dhurandhar 2 Leaves Viewers Shaken Yet Hooked A user on X shared their early reaction to Dhurandhar 2, calling it an intense and gripping watch despite its violent tone. “It’s INTERVAL… #DhurandharTheRevenge is one of THE MOST VIOLENT films I have ever seen. A few scenes are too DISTURBING!” they wrote, adding that the film still manages to keep audiences invested. Praising the lead star, the user further stated, “But yes, it’s THOROUGHLY ENGAGING & INTRIGUING so far and #RanveerSingh has killed it. His BEST PERFORMANCE to date.” Dhurandhar 2 Scene Has Fans Recalling Akshaye Khanna's FA9LA Moment Fans took to X to draw comparisons between a scene featuring Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar 2 and Akshaye Khanna’s FA9LA scene from the first instalment. Madras High Court Restrains Illegal Broadcast Of Dhurandhar 2 According to Bar and Bench, the Madras High Court issued an ad interim injunction on Wednesday, barring internet service providers and cable TV operators from illegally airing Dhurandhar 2 before its March 19 release. Dhurandhar 2: Film Exhibitors Bet Big On The Ranveer Singh-Starrer With packed houses for the paid previews, the success of part one still buzzing, and its release coinciding with Eid and Gudi Padwa holidays, Dhurandhar: The Revenge is set for a bumper opening, with industry insiders and trade pundits looking at the Aditya Dhar film setting box office records.The Ranveer Singh-starrer, which comes soon after Dhurandhar, releases in cinemas on Thursday, and more than 15 lakh tickets have already been sold. This includes the paid previews, which begin from 5.30 pm on Wednesday."At PVR INOX, we have not seen this sort of advance booking even pre-COVID-19... The excitement is phenomenal; there's no precedent. It looks like the film is going to take a massive opening. We are looking at a strong finish to March and a strong start to April," Kamal Gianchandani, chief business planning & strategy, PVR INOX Limited, told PTI."I hope it breaks the record of Dhurandhar Part 1 and hope it turns out to be the first film to cross Rs 1,000 crore nett box office in Hindi, besides the contribution from dubbed versions in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam. I hope that's an addition to Rs 1,000 crore," he added. Dhurandhar 2 Early Reviews Early reactions to Dhurandhar: The Revenge have started pouring in as the film began its paid previews on March 18, and the response so far points to a massive cinematic spectacle led by Ranveer Singh and directed by Aditya Dhar. Read the full story here. Trade Analyst Reviews Dhurandhar 2 Trade analyst Taran Adarsh took to X to review Dhurandhar 2. He wrote, "The expectations from the sequel to #Dhurandhar were naturally sky-high... Thankfully, #DhurandharTheRevenge not only meets those mammoth expectations – it surpasses them by leaps and bounds." Dhurandhar 2: Viewers Slam Poor Management As Shows Start Late A viewer has flagged a frustrating experience at a cinema hall during the paid previews of Dhurandhar 2.Taking to X, the user described the situation as “absolute chaos” at the multiplex, claiming that shows were running behind schedule. According to the post, their screening at Cinepolis Nexus Westend in Pune, which was slated to begin at 5 PM, had not started even by 5:30 PM, leaving audiences visibly annoyed.The viewer expressed their irritation over the lack of updates or clarity from the theatre staff. Dhurandhar 2 Not Screened In Dolby Vision At Allu Cinemas Due To Delay Amid ongoing screening disruptions, Allu Arjun's Allu Cinemas has issued a fresh update for Dhurandhar 2, informing audiences about a change in its exhibition format.During the paid previews, they displayed the message: "Due to a delay in receiving the Dolby Vision files, we are unable to screen the film in Dolby Vision format. The current screening will be in 4K projection with Dolby Atmos sound." Aditya Dhar Apologises For Dhurandhar 2 Show Cancellations Amid confusion over show cancellations and delays, filmmaker Aditya Dhar has addressed audiences with an official statement regarding the release of Dhurandhar 2.Taking to X, Dhar shared that the film holds deep emotional value for the team. He wrote, "To our dear Dhurandhar family, Dhurandhar is not just a film for us - it is something we have lived with, nurtured, and dreamed of sharing with each and every one of you, together, at the same moment, in every language.""Most of our Hindi shows across India are running as scheduled from 5 pm onwards. All of our Tamil and Telugu shows will commence from 9 pm onwards. However due to unforeseen technical difficulties, our Malayalam and Kannada shows will begin from tomorrow morning," Dhar added."If the dubbed version you have tickets for is not currently playing at your cinema, you will have an option for refund or to watch the Hindi version with subtitles Instead. We truly apologise for the inconvenience. Your love for this film means the world to us, and we cannot wait to share it with you. Team Jio Studios and B62 Studios," the director concluded. Aditya Dhar Posts A Dhurandhar 2 Spoiler Before Release A few hours ahead of the release, director Aditya Dhar shared a long note on Instagram, expressing gratitude to audiences and making a heartfelt appeal to protect the film's viewing experience by avoiding spoilers. In his caption, the filmmaker also urged viewers to stay in their seats until the end credits roll. Read the full story here. Dhurandhar 2 Faces Show Cancellations In Delhi In Delhi NCR, Dhurandhar 2 is facing last-minute exhibition issues.All IMAX bookings have reportedly been taken offline, while several cinema chains including Miraj, Movietime, Wave, Cinepolis, Moviemax and certain INOX properties are said to be cancelling their 5:00 PM to 5:30 PM shows. Claims further suggest that while major PVR chains are still trying to proceed as scheduled, smaller PVR multiplexes are also cancelling screenings. Where To Watch Dhurandhar 2 On OTT Dhurandhar 2 is set to premiere on JioHotstar following its theatrical run. The first part released on Netflix on January 30, 2026. Paid Previews Of Dhurandhar 2 Delayed In Noida Elvin Marcus, the manager of MovieMax Laserplex hall at Gulshan One 29 in Noida, told NDTV that the delay in the 5 pm paid preview was caused by last-minute edits to the film following cuts and modifications suggested by the Censor Board. The show is expected to begin around 6 pm. Shows Cancelled At Mumbai's Gaiety Galaxy Shows at Gaiety Galaxy in Mumbai have been cancelled amid ongoing delays, leaving crowds frustrated. Theatre staff are reportedly suggesting audiences to opt for the 9 pm show as technical issues continue to disrupt operations across venues. Huge Crowd Gathers Outside Bandra Theatre A huge crowd has gathered outside Gaiety Galaxy in Bandra as the shows are running late. The 4:45 pm screening has still not started. Delays are being reported everywhere because theatres must first download the film and then receive the KDM (Key Delivery Message), which grants permission to play it, leaving audiences waiting impatiently. Exclusive: Why Dhurandhar 2 Cancelled Non-Hindi Shows In South The much-anticipated release of Dhurandhar: The Revenge has hit an unexpected hurdle in the southern markets.While the movie has begun rolling out paid previews in parts of the country, audiences in Tamil Nadu and other southern regions have been left disappointed after several theatres cancelled their non-Hindi shows at the last minute.Cinema chains across key cities cited "non-availability" of content as the primary reason behind the cancellations. This has led to confusion among moviegoers, especially those who had booked tickets for the dubbed Tamil and Telugu versions of the Ranveer Singh-starrer.Explaining the situation, trade analyst Ramesh Bala told NDTV how the technical issues led to the delay. Read the full story here. After Na De Dil Pardesi Nu, Dhurandhar Makers Bring Back Another Punjabi Hit Song Ari Ari If Dhurandhar part one revived Na De Dil Pardesi Nu, an early 2000s Punjabi party banger, Dhurandhar: The Revenge has brought back the memories of Ari Ari, a 2003 song by Bombay Rockers. Read more about Ari Ari here. 100 Records Dhurandhar Broke In 100 Days At The Theatres Dhurandhar 2 is arriving in theatres, days after the first part of the film re-released in cinemas around the world. Dhurandhar one has been in theatres since its release date: December 5, 2025, more than 100 days in cinema halls. Read about the 100 records Dhurandhar broke in its 100 days in theatres here. Dhurandhar 2 Paid Previews Set To Begin Soon Dhurandhar 2 paid previews across India are set to start soon. Cinemas will begin screening the film in shows as early as 4.30 pm and 5 pm in cities, including Delhi and Mumbai. 'Peak Detailing': Here's How Dhurandhar 2 Director Aditya Dhar Celebrated His 43rd Birthday Dhurandhar 2 director Aditya Dhar celebrated his 43rd birthday, a week before the release of the film. From enjoying viral 'peak detailing' memes, reading fan theories, to working on finishing touches, this is how Aditya Dhar marked his special day. Read the full story here. 8 Dhurandhar Questions Dhurandhar 2 Needs To Answer As Dhurandhar 2 hits the theatres today for paid previews, here are eight burning questions that the highly-anticipated sequel must answer. Read the full story here. Dhurandhar 2 Is Gearing Up For Early Shows In Mumbai Mumbai will wake up as early as 2 am to rush to the theatres to catch Dhurandhar 2 before the crack of dawn. According to BookMyShow advance bookings, many multiplexes have scheduled shows at 2.15 am, 2.20 am, and 2.45 am for the Ranveer Singh film, directed by Aditya Dhar. Read the full story here. "Main Pakistani Nahin": Dhurandhar Actor Issues Clarification Over Terrorist And 'Hindu Darpok Qaum' Dialogue Dhurandhar actor Vivek Sinha, who played Zahoor Mistry, one of the five hijackers who hijacked the Indian Airlines flight IC-814 in 1999, recently shared a video on Instagram clarifying that he is not Pakistani and certainly not a terrorist. Read the full story here. He posted the video after his famous "Hindu Darpok Qaum" dialogue from Dhurandhar part one picked up more steam with the release of Dhurandhar 2 trailer. Pakistani Singer Says Dhurandhar Team Paid Him Rs 46 Lakh For Hawa Hawa Remember Sanjay Dutt's easy-breezy entry as SP Chaudhary Aslam in Dhurandhar to the popular 1986 song Hawa Hawa sung by Pakistani singer Hasan Jahangir? The singer recently revealed that the film makers paid him Rs 46 lakh (USD 50,000) as royalty for using the song in the film. Read the full story here. Bonus: A clip of Sanjay Dutt's entry in Dhurandhar: Before RGV, This Person Watched Dhurandhar 2. This Is What Their Review Said Long before Ram Gopal Varma watched Dhurandhar 2, actor Yami Gautam had seen her husband's movie and had great things to say about it. This is what Yami Gautam, who also stars in a key role in Dhurandhar 2, shared about the movie. Read here. Rs 150 Crore And Counting: How Much Has Dhurandhar 2 Earned In Advance Booking? Know more about the advance booking status of Dhurandhar 2, a day before its worldwide release, here. Dhurandhar 2 Director's First Film Was Supposed To Star Fawad Khan Aditya Dhar's directorial debut came in 2019 with Uri: The Surgical Strike. Did you know he was not originally planning his debut with the Vicky Kaushal movie? Read more here. Is Turban-Wearing Ranveer Singh 'Smoking A Cigarette' In A Dhurandhar 2 Song? A Fact-Check Ahead of the grand release of Dhurandhar 2, Ranveer Singh's film is facing backlash from the Sikh community over a fan-made poster. The poster in question shows a turban-wearing Ranveer Singh smoking a cigarette. Read the full story here. Dhurandhar 2 Tamil Shows Cancelled In Tamil Nadu Theatres Broadway Cinemas, which have theatres in Coimbatore and Tiruppur, have cancelled the Tamil-language paid preview shows of Dhurandhar 2 "due to non-availability". Read the full story here. Dhurandhar 2 Runtime Decoded How long is Dhurandhar 2? Does the Ranveer Singh-starrer have a runtime longer than its part one? Read more here. Dhurandhar 2 Preview Day Begins With Launch Of A Brand New Song On Dhurandhar 2 preview day, makers of the Ranveer Singh film released a new song, titled Main Aur Tu. The track, composed by Shashank Sachdeva, is sung by Jasmine Sandlas and Reble. When Dhurandhar 2 Director Aditya Dhar Addressed 'Propaganda' Claims About Uri Ahead of Dhurandhar 2 release, Aditya Dhar's old interview with film critic Rajeev Masand has gone viral. In the interview, the filmmaker addressed "propaganda" claims about his debut feature Uri: The Surgical Strike, which was released in 2019. 'Peak Detailing': Dhurandhar 2 Memes Are Here To Rule From viral memes to fans dissecting the trailer and discussing what's in store for Ranveer Singh's Hamza Ali Mazari/ Jaskirat Singh Rangi, Dhurandhar 2 has already taken the Internet by storm. Read the full story here. Aditya Dhar's 'One Request' Before Dhurandhar 2 Release Dhurandhar 2, starring Ranveer Singh, R Madhavan, Sanjay Dutt and Arjun Rampal, will be released in theatres tomorrow, with paid previews available from today. Meanwhile, the film’s director, Aditya Dhar, has urged fans not to share spoilers from the film. Read the full story here. When Dhurandhar 2 Director Reacted To Uri 'Propaganda' Claims A day ahead of Dhurandhar 2 release, Aditya Dhar's old interview with film critic Rajeev Masand went viral, where he addressed "propaganda" claims for his debut feature Uri: The Surgical Strike. Read the full story here. Dhurandhar 2 Release Live Updates: A Powerful Ensemble Cast Returns Dhurandhar 2 sees R Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sanjay Dutt, Sara Arjun, Danish Pandor, Gaurav Gera, and Rakesh Bedi reprise their respective roles from the first movie. The film is backed by Jio Studios and B62 Studios. Dhurandhar 2 Release Live Updates: Box Office Clash With 'Toxic' Averted Dhurandhar 2 was earlier facing a box office clash with the Kannada movie Toxic, starring KGF star Yash, directed by Geetu Mohandas. However, the makers of Toxic postponed the release of the film in the wake of the Iran-Israel War. Now, the Aditya Dhar-directed Dhurandhar 2 is getting a solo release, raring to dominate the ticket window, just like its part one.Read the full story here. Aari Aari Sets The Tone For Ranveer Singh’s Fierce Rise In Dhurandhar 2 The song Aari Aari from Dhurandhar 2 is composed by Shashwat Sachdev, with vocals by Navraj Hans of Bombay Rockers fame and lyrics written by Irshad Kamil. It underscores the raw energy and intensity of the film, reflecting the story’s shift towards the rise of Ranveer Singh’s character as "Sher-E-Baloch". Ranveer Singh's Big Comment Ahead Of Dhurandhar 2 Release Ranveer Singh attended the grand music launch of Dhurandhar: The Revenge in Mumbai on March 17, where he spoke about the strong response to Aditya Dhar’s film and said he is still taking in the support and appreciation it has received. Read here. Ram Gopal Varma Reviews Dhurandhar 2 Ram Gopal Varma says "all the greatest films made so far, starting from Mughal-e-Azam and Sholay," will look like 'TV serials' compared to Aditya Dhar's film.​ Read full story here. Finland President And Canadian PM Talk Dhurandhar On Morning Jog A video posted by Finland President Alexander Stubb has drawn attention online after it showed him jogging through London's Hyde Park with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and their spouses. In the video, Stubb and Carney are seen briefly discussing Dhurandhar while jogging. Read here. Dhurandhar 2 Behading Scene Censored As per the certification report, the CBFC suggested 4 out of 21 major modifications, all involving visuals of extreme violence. These include reductions in moments described as "smashing the eye," "beheading and kicking," "hitting the head with a cement block," and "hitting the head with a hammer." Read here. Dhurandhar Recap Inspired by real events, Dhurandhar presented a gripping two-part espionage thriller centred on an Indian spy working undercover in Karachi. The story tracked an intelligence officer’s efforts to infiltrate criminal syndicates and political circles in order to dismantle a terror network posing a threat to India’s security. Dhurandhar 2 Cast Directed by Aditya Dhar, Dhurandhar: The Revenge features Ranveer Singh, Sara Arjun, Sanjay Dutt, R Madhavan, and Arjun Rampal in key roles. Dhurandhar 2 Title Announcement The makers of Dhurandhar announced the title of the sequel, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, and unveiled its first poster on February 3. The poster featured Ranveer Singh at the centre against a dark, rain-filled backdrop dominated by red tones. Dhurandhar 2 To Be Released In 5 Languages Unlike Dhurandhar, which was released only in Hindi, the sequel will be released in five languages, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam. Dhurandhar 2 Release Details Ranveer Singh–led Dhurandhar: The Revenge will officially release in theatres on March 19, with paid preview shows scheduled for today, March 18.
